claims.statement: COHR Sherman 6 吋 InP 廠獲政府端 costly commitment：CHIPS Act LOI 最高 $50M 直接資助（美國商務部，指定用途為 6 吋 InP 產能擴張）＋德州 TSIF/Sherman EDC 先期約 $20M；擴建目標為廠房翻倍、晶圓產能翻四倍。與 NVIDIA $2B（買方）合看，該廠同時有買方與政府雙重外部資本背書；LOI 非已撥付，附里程碑條件。

source_doc.title: Semiconductor Today: Coherent to receive $50m US CHIPS Act funding to expand Sherman 6-inch InP fab

sources.quote: Coherent Corp of Saxonburg, PA, USA has signed a letter of intent to receive up to $50m in direct funding under the CHIPS and Science Act from the US Department of Commerce to expand its 6-inch indium phosphide (InP) photonic device manufacturing facility in Sherman, Texas.
The expansion will double manufacturing production space and quadruple wafer production capacity, significantly increasing domestic US-based production of critical AI-enabling technologies.
The CHIPS award builds on about $20m in support previously provided through the Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund and the Sherman Economic Development Corporation.
